dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Snew p. Dog was recently returned to the care center due to his reactivity. Snew was reported to bark and lunge at the previous adopter's roommate and had to be held to deescalate the situation. While in care, Snew has been observed to be highly reactive. During intake he was observed to hard bark and lunge at staff. At one point Snew redirected onto the handler and snapped at their pants. On the street, Snew will also react to dogs and is unable to be redirected. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced, adult only, single pet home with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Snew P. Dog
